title: Algorithmic Fairness: A Tolerance Perspective
benchmark_measurement: The incorrect association of non-hate-speech terms related to religious groups (e.g., 'Muslim') with hate speech by detection models.
models_tested: Word embedding models (GloVe, Hard-GloVe, GN-GloVe, etc.)
Machine translation models (Google Translate, Bing, DeepL, etc.)
Computer Vision models (Amazon Rekognition, Google Cloud Vision, etc.)
findings: The paper cites research showing that many existing hate-speech detection models incorrectly associate non-hate-speech terms, such as 'Muslim', with potential hate speech due to them being trigger words.
